detailed_notes.e11_tier_matrix_success: The MOST CRITICAL test for this iteration - validating that the user's actual 6,426-row file (IMPOR_PRODUK_COLLECTOR_PARFUM_1.xlsx with all prices=0) can be processed using the tier matrix feature. This test PASSED completely: (1) File analyzed in ~6 seconds, (2) 24-cell matrix rendered correctly with 4 tiers and 6 dimension combinations, (3) Quick-fill populated all cells with 150000, (4) Preview accurately showed 'Akan mengisi 6.426 harga', (5) Apply operation completed in ~10 seconds, (6) All 6,426 rows validated successfully, (7) 1,071 products detected, (8) Import button activated. This proves the E12 session-based import (session_id instead of sending 6,426 rows repeatedly) is working as designed and solves the user's original problem.
detailed_notes.session_management: Session management works correctly when maintaining continuous browser context. Login persists across navigation within same session. No token expiration issues encountered (iteration 36's concern was a harness artifact).
detailed_notes.502_error_context: 502 Bad Gateway occurred after ~15 minutes of testing. Services were running (supervisorctl confirmed). Site recovered quickly. Same issue occurred in iteration 34. This is an infrastructure/pod stability issue, not an application bug. Does not affect production deployment.
